metadata.title: CNAB 444 Status Checker
metadata.description: Upload a CNAB 444 remittance file and check the status of each invoice.

home.title: CNAB 444 Status Checker
home.description: Upload the remittance file to validate its layout and check the status of each invoice.

upload.heading: Remittance file
upload.instructions: Drag the remittance file here or click to choose it
upload.hint: CNAB 444 (.rem or .txt), up to {maxKilobytes} KB and {maxReceivables} receivables
upload.ready: {count, plural, one {# receivable} other {# receivables}} ready to check in {fileName}.
upload.invalidCheckDigits: {count, plural, one {# key has} other {# keys have}} an invalid check digit; they will be checked anyway.
upload.truncated: There are more problems besides these.

check.heading: Invoice statuses
check.started: Checking {total, plural, one {# receivable} other {# receivables}} with the Fattor API.
check.completed: Check finished: {total, plural, one {# receivable checked} other {# receivables checked}}{failed, plural, =0 {.} other {, # failed.}}
check.credentialsRejected: The Fattor API refused the server credentials, so the check was stopped. Try again later.
check.interrupted: The check stopped before the end. Receivables without a status can be checked again.
check.tableCaption: Status of each receivable in the file, in line order
check.invalidCheckDigitHint: This key's check digit doesn't match; its status is still checked.

detail.title: Receivable {ordinal}
detail.xrayCaption: Line {lineNumber} of the file, with the 444 positions of the record.

filters.searchHint: Type any part of the key; spaces, dots and dashes are ignored.
filters.matches: {count, plural, =0 {No receivables found.} one {# receivable found.} other {# receivables found.}}

requestErrors.NETWORK_ERROR: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
requestErrors.UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE: The server gave an unexpected answer (code {status}).
requestErrors.INVALID_REQUEST: The server did not accept the upload.
requestErrors.CROSS_SITE_REQUEST: The upload was blocked because it came from another origin.
requestErrors.LENGTH_REQUIRED: The browser did not send the file size.

rejections.INVALID_FILE: The file does not follow the CNAB 444 layout.
rejections.TOO_MANY_RECEIVABLES: The file has {actual} receivables; the limit is {max} per upload.
rejections.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {maxKilobytes} KB.
rejections.MULTIPLE_FILES: Upload one file at a time.
rejections.UNREADABLE_FILE: The file could not be read. It may be a folder or it may have been moved; choose it again.

issues.INVALID_LINE_LENGTH: Line {lineNumber}: {actual, plural, =0 {is empty} one {has # character} other {has # characters}}; {expected} are expected.
issues.UNEXPECTED_RECORD_TYPE: Line {lineNumber}: record of type “{actual}”; expected {expected, select, header {a header (0)} detail {a detail (1)} trailer {a trailer (9)} other {type {expected}}}.
issues.UNEXPECTED_BLANK_LINE: Line {lineNumber}: is blank; expected {expected, select, header {a header (0)} detail {a detail (1)} trailer {a trailer (9)} other {type {expected}}}.
issues.MISSING_DETAIL_RECORDS: The file has no detail records (type 1).
issues.INVALID_RECORD_COUNT: Line {lineNumber}: the trailer does not state a valid record count.
issues.RECORD_COUNT_MISMATCH: Line {lineNumber}: the trailer states {declared, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}, but the file has {actual}.
issues.INVALID_ACCESS_KEY_FORMAT: Line {lineNumber}: the NF-e access key (columns 401–444) is not in a valid format.
